write_gate_default: off (GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES unset/0; this proposal does not read, set, or touch writes_allowed() or WRITE_COMMANDS anywhere)
current_behavior_measured: RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST is a static dict keyed by exact (runner, topic) tuples for 11 stable topic-continuous workers, plus one hardcoded codex-runner wildcard (any topic). There is no entry and no prefix/pattern mechanism for topic=='task_mcp'. Any per-wave runner name like 'claude_task_mcp_allowlist_dryrun_b05' is rejected with reason=unknown_runner_topic_pair even though it is a well-formed identity token that already passed _is_malformed_identity_token.

proposed_change.description: Add a bounded, explicit, ADDITIVE per-wave prefix-allowlist rule scoped to topic=='task_mcp' only. This stays a deterministic safety/support-boundary gate (CLAUDE.md carve-out for moral/safety/support-boundary/rollback/correctness checks) -- it is NOT a learned routing decision and does not touch or replace any neural selection path. No other topic's behavior changes.
proposed_change.check_runner_topic_allowlist_diff_sketch: After the existing line `allowed_actions = RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST.get((runner, topic))` returns None (today's only path for task_mcp), add: `rule = PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST.get(topic)` then `if rule is not None and runner.startswith(rule["runner_prefix"]):` -> `if action in rule["actions"]: return {"allowed": True, "reason": "per_wave_prefix_allowlisted"}` else `return {"allowed": False, "reason": f"per_wave_action_not_allowed:{action}"}`. If the prefix does not match, fall through unchanged to the existing `return {"allowed": False, "reason": "unknown_runner_topic_pair"}`.
proposed_change.action_scope_rationale: start and done are intentionally EXCLUDED from the per-wave action set (only auto-pickup/review/usage are allowed) as an extra-conservative default: per-wave dry-run/design workers never call taskctl start directly in the observed protocol, and done remains Codex-exclusive via the untouched CODEX_RUNNER wildcard path.
proposed_change.malformed_token_check_unchanged: The existing _is_malformed_identity_token(runner) / _is_malformed_identity_token(topic) sanity checks run FIRST and are not bypassed or reordered by this change -- prefix matching only ever runs after both tokens already passed the charset/null/empty checks.
proposed_change.backward_compatibility: Purely additive: RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST (the dict, all 11 tuples, all 4 actions per tuple) and the CODEX_RUNNER wildcard branch are not modified, reordered, or removed. Every existing (runner, topic, action) triple must return a byte-identical {allowed, reason} result before and after the patch. Only outcomes for topic=='task_mcp' with an unknown-until-now runner change (from unknown_runner_topic_pair to either allowed=true/per_wave_prefix_allowlisted or per_wave_action_not_allowed).

safe_patterns_for_generalization.note: Informational, NOT proposed for application in this same patch -- flagged for a future task if the owner wants it. Other per-wave-style topics observed in project memory that are ALSO absent from the static dict (out of scope here): claude_shared_axis/shared_axis, claude_inference_closure/inference_closure. The same PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST dict shape generalizes to those by adding further topic keys with their own runner_prefix/actions -- each addition should be its own reviewed, gated, additive entry, never a broad regex intent router.

required_tests_for_the_real_patch: unit: check_runner_topic_allowlist('claude_task_mcp_<anything>', 'task_mcp', 'start') -> allowed False, reason per_wave_action_not_allowed:start (excluded action)
unit: check_runner_topic_allowlist('not_claude_task_mcp_prefixed', 'task_mcp', 'auto-pickup') -> allowed False, reason unknown_runner_topic_pair (prefix must match, no wildcard escape)

unit: check_runner_topic_allowlist('claude_task_mcp_ b05', 'task_mcp', 'auto-pickup') -> allowed False, reason malformed_runner:invalid_characters (space still rejected before the new prefix path is ever reached)
regression: for all 11 existing static (runner, topic) pairs x their 4 actions, {allowed, reason} is identical before and after the patch (byte-for-byte dict comparison)
regression: codex wildcard behavior (any topic, actions in CODEX_ALLOWED_ACTIONS) unchanged

rollback.action: Revert the PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST constant and the added branch inside check_runner_topic_allowlist in a single commit; RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST and all other functions are untouched so rollback is a pure code revert with zero data migration and zero registry changes.
trigger_conditions: any existing static pair's {allowed, reason} changes
any topic other than task_mcp gains unintended access
malformed-token rejection stops running before the prefix check

neural_bridge_note.doctrine: This proposal only widens a deterministic safety/support-boundary allowlist (permitted under CLAUDE.md's neural-control-first carve-out); it introduces no keyword/regex cognition for task-type, tool, or route SELECTION. Real learned launch-routing remains tracked separately.
